techniques.name: Separate editable project references from rendered output
techniques.intent: Prevent missing assets when reopening an editable timeline.

operations: register each original asset with a stable identifier
relink missing asset by explicit mapping and matching hash
render a separate self-contained video when requested
code_expression.timing: Validate every referenced asset before any timeline render.

pitfalls: A project file is not a rendered movie.
Renaming or moving original files can break references; exporting does not repair the editable project.
The tutorial UI is from older footage and does not establish current menu names.
validation: Missing-reference validation names the affected asset.
Relink only after matching identity, then reopen or decode expected source.

techniques.name: Represent timeline placement, overlap, canvas and audio as separate state
techniques.intent: Translate drag-and-drop editing into explicit, reproducible temporal and spatial composition.

operations: place clips with source_in/source_out and timeline_start
composite active visual layers in ascending z order
apply scale, position and rotation before compositing
place and mix audio independently of visual z order
preserve aspect by fit or deliberately choose crop
code_expression.timing: Layer interval [timeline_start,timeline_start+(source_out-source_in)/speed). Snap target is an existing clip boundary or marker.

pitfalls: Switching ratio alone can expose black margins.
Upper opaque solids can cover video.
Track order and timeline start are separate variables.
Visible values are the demonstrated current state, not required defaults.
validation: Check canvas ratio and fit/crop choice.
Inspect visual and audio layers separately.

techniques.name: Frame-aware splitting and beat markers with explicit export settings
techniques.intent: Make timing edits precise while choosing export settings from source properties.

operations: quantize split location to output frame grid
split one clip preserving source continuity

export_fps.rule: Derive from desired delivery and actual footage; examples are not universal requirements.

code_expression.timing: source_split=source_in+(playhead-timeline_start)*speed; adjacent pieces share this source boundary.

pitfalls: Manual markers do not guarantee every cut should follow a beat.
Old shortcuts/menu behavior may have changed.
validation: No gap or duplicate frame at split.
Markers stay aligned after trimming/moving audio.
Decode output and verify its actual dimensions/fps.

unknowns: No audio was auditioned; ASR is unverified and contains spelling errors.
Full-resolution frames are discrete evidence, not continuous playback.
Current Jianying UI and original asset licensing are not established by this lesson.
